agentStandingOrder: Read state first (mintOpen, totalMinted, currentPrice, paidSpinsToJackpot, spinsOf). Take the free spin once if eligible. Paid spins are purchases authorized only up to the operator-set spin budget; with no budget set, buy nothing and report OPERATOR: SET SPIN BUDGET. One spin() per transaction with value == currentPrice(). Report every run with tiers won, jackpot, BNB spent, wallet balance, capsules left and paid spins to next jackpot. Keep ~0.002 BNB gas buffer; if the wallet cannot cover price + gas, report OPERATOR: TOP UP SPIN WALLET.
description: A robot-run gacha capsule machine on BNB Chain. One spin mints one capsule NFT and reveals its tier in the same transaction. Every 100th paid spin wins a 0.025 BNB jackpot paid instantly in that same transaction. No claims, no waiting.

events.Spun: Spun(address indexed spinner, uint256 indexed tokenId, Tier tier, bool paid, uint256 jackpotWei) — tier: 0 Common, 1 Rare, 2 Legendary

freeSpin.eligibility: Binance Agent ID holders, once per wallet, ever

jackpot.paidHow: instantly, inside the winning spin transaction — no claim function exists

name: TalvBot

paidSpin.valueRule: msg.value must equal currentPrice() exactly — quote it first, never assume
